g.text: Cable-level diagram: every power interface includes positive AND protected return. No connection to raw cell B-.

g.desc: Cable-level diagram: every power interface includes positive AND protected return. No connection to raw cell B-.

g.text: Use a true buck-boost charger across the station battery voltage range. CC/CV supply alone is not charge management.

g.desc: Use a true buck-boost charger across the station battery voltage range. CC/CV supply alone is not charge management.

g.text: Charge-source management must prevent backfeed, enforce combined current/temperature limits and preserve termination.

g.desc: Charge-source management must prevent backfeed, enforce combined current/temperature limits and preserve termination.

g.text: Dock needs current limiting, contact sequencing, polarity protection and motion inhibit; Hall detection alone is insufficient.

g.desc: Dock needs current limiting, contact sequencing, polarity protection and motion inhibit; Hall detection alone is insufficient.

g.text: Validate series-panel cold Voc against 100V MPPT limit and Vmp headroom. Roof solar is supplemental, not 8A charging.

g.desc: Validate series-panel cold Voc against 100V MPPT limit and Vmp headroom. Roof solar is supplemental, not 8A charging.

g.text: Optional independent beacon is not included in the shared robot rail; give it its own protected battery/charger power path.

g.desc: Optional independent beacon is not included in the shared robot rail; give it its own protected battery/charger power path.

g.text: Station LiFePO4 and robot Li-ion need DIFFERENT charging profiles. Do not tie the batteries together.

g.desc: Station LiFePO4 and robot Li-ion need DIFFERENT charging profiles. Do not tie the batteries together.

g.text: Simplest prototype: one charge source selected at a time, robot off while charging, appropriate BMS connected.

g.desc: Simplest prototype: one charge source selected at a time, robot off while charging, appropriate BMS connected.
